title: Completed Transition to Operations Checklist Data Contract
description: Additive structural schema validating completed Transition to Operations Checklist artifact data payloads (PMO-07.04).

handover_item.description: The operational deliverable, documentation, system asset, credentials, warranty, or support agreement formally transferred to the sustaining operations team.

responsible_party.description: The operational team, service owner, or designated role accepting ongoing responsibility and stewardship for the item.

acceptance_criteria.description: The specific operational readiness criteria and verification evidence required before formal handover sign-off.

handover_date.description: The scheduled or actual date on which ownership and support accountability are formally transferred.

sign_off_status.description: The formal verification status (e.g., Accepted, Conditional, Pending) confirming operational readiness.
